Single Brain, Dual Surface Blueprint: Surgical OpenXML AST (<w:p> / <w:ins> / <w:del>) · Word Office.js Add-In · Google Docs batchUpdate API · Zero Round-Trip Conversion
Keep exact container format it was opened in.
Routes to Track A (OpenXML AST / Office.js)
Routes to Track B (Google Docs batchUpdate)
Routes to Track C (docxtpl Native .docx Jinja2)
• Evaluates Weil Playbook v3.4 rules & caps
• Serves BOTH Gemini Enterprise Web Canvas
AND Native Word / Google Workspace Add-ins
Zero UI Replication of M365 Ribbon Tools
ZONE 2 — TRACK A: NATIVE MICROSOFT WORD (.DOCX OPENXML) PRESERVATION
SURFACE A1 · GEMINI ENTERPRISE WEB CANVAS (STUDIO 2)
2A. Surgical Headless OpenXML AST Engine (No M365 Required)
• Unzips counterparty .docx in memory; parses word/document.xml via lxml / python-docx
• Locates exact target paragraph node (<w:p w14:paraId="4829A10C"> — Section 8.02(a))
• Injects native Word Track Changes (<w:del> & <w:ins w:author="Gemini Legal AI">) inside <w:p>
<!-- word/document.xml: Paragraph style & 9-level numbering stay 100% intact -->
✓ word/styles.xml: UNCHANGED (0 diff) · word/numbering.xml: UNCHANGED (0 diff)
SURFACE A2 · NATIVE WORD TASK PANE ADD-IN (OFFICE.JS)
2B. Live Co-Editing Inside Desktop Word / M365 Web (When Typing Heavily)
• Same Studio 2 UI loads in Word's right-hand Task Pane (380px pip mode via manifest.xml)
• Word natively renders .docx on the left; Gemini applies surgical edits via Office.js API:
2C. Native .docx Master Templates for New Riders & FundGen Side Letters
• Used ONLY when generating a brand-new rider (Legal Legos / LP Side Letters), NEVER for redlines
• Injects structured JSON into Weil's pre-styled .docx master template via docxtpl (Jinja2 AST)
✓ Output: 100% Format-Locked .docx · Passes Counterparty Litera Compare with Zero False Diffs
ZONE 3 — TRACK B: NATIVE GOOGLE DOCS (BATCHUPDATE API) PRESERVATION
SURFACE B1 & B2 · GOOGLE DOCS + GEMINI SIDE PANEL
3A. Native Google Docs Iframe (/edit?rm=minimal) or Workspace Add-On
• When opened as a Google Doc, it stays a native Google Doc on Google Drive
• Left pane renders live Google Doc; right pane hosts Gemini 3.8 Flash assistant
• Reads structural AST via docs.documents.get(documentId) with exact UTF-16 indices
Why Formatting Never Breaks in Google Docs Mode:
Edits mutate text inside existing paragraph ranges, inheriting NamedStyles & kix list IDs.
• Mutates character offsets [startIndex: 1420, endIndex: 1618] inside paragraph node
• Wraps every AI-modified clause in a Google Docs NamedRange (weil_clause_8_02_a)
• Enforces writeControl.requiredRevisionId so concurrent human edits never collide
• Logs exact before/after diff + Playbook citation into Cloud Spanner WeilLegalGraph
✓ Output: 100% Native Google Doc with Zero Alignment or Outline Drift
ZONE 4 — CONCRETE OUTPUT PROOF: WHY FORMAT-LOCKED ROUTING SUCCEEDS VS. WHY ROUND-TRIP CONVERSION FAILS
